name: tradeindia-b2b-supplier-scraper
title: TradeIndia Supplier Scraper: B2B Products & MOQ
description: Scrape public TradeIndia supplier and product listings by keyword, including company names, business type, location, prices, MOQ, trust flags, websites, product URLs, and images.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

supplier-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean TradeIndia supplier/product record saved to the dataset.
